title: Danny Healy-Rae's actions a 'scud missile', says brother
desc: Former minister Michael Healy-Rae has described the actions of his older brother, Danny, as akin to those of a "scud missile" blaming them for leading to his resignation as a junior minister.

title: An Acadian flag emoji? Online petition gathers thousands of signatures
desc: Alexis Belliveau and Julien Robichaud are submitting an application for the creation of an Acadian flag emoji to the organization that reviews and approves emojis. Their online petition launched Tuesday has garnered over 10,000 signatures.

title: Lani Pallister Hands Katie Ledecky Her First Ever International Loss In The Women's 800 Free
desc: Lani Pallister took the win in the 800 free at the Pan Pacific Championships last night, Ledecky's first and only senior defeat in the event in 14 years

title: Pray for GoldBod; ‘very powerful movement’ opposing it - Duncan-Williams
desc: Founder and General Overseer of Action Chapel International, Archbishop Nicholas Duncan-Williams, has called on Ghanaians to pray for the Ghana Gold Board

title: Rebel Creamery files Chapter 11 with $23.8M Van Leeuwen judgment on appeal
desc: Rebel Creamery filed for Chapter 11 in Utah with a $23.785 million Van Leeuwen trade-dress judgment listed as a disputed claim under appeal.

title: Oppo, OnePlus, Realme phones to be made by Amber Enterprises in India from FY28
desc: Oppo moving to Amber is an indicator that the Chinese mobile brands, which emerged from a common group, are moving towards asset-light models by reducing their manufacturing exposure in India.

title: Akuapem North MP Sammi Awuku Denies Reports of Eoco Arrest, Video
desc: Akuapem North MP Sammi Awuku has denied claims of his arrest by the Economic and Organised Crime Office (EOCO). His discussion with Appiah Stadium has gone viral.

title: July's Jobs Report Is Ugly. Strip Out the World Cup Hangover and It's Even Uglier
desc: The stock market is hitting record highs, but beneath the surface a jobs report just flashed four simultaneous warning signals that investors chasing momentum are dangerously close to missing.

title: North East train delays LIVE: Updates as passengers face disruption on East Coast Main Line
desc: Rail services have been delayed on Sunday morning with disruption between Newcastle and Darlington

title: Attorney General Todd Blanche says the DOJ may take states’ voter roll fight to Supreme Court
desc: Todd Blanche said there’s a “possibility” that the Justice Department will ask the Supreme Court to rule on cases where the federal government’s is attempting to gain access to state voter rolls ahead of November’s midterm elections.
